drafter.private_reasoning: I kept the response settlement-forward and standardized the draft without disclosing any internal evaluation. The edits tighten payment timing, narrow the release, add practical confidentiality carve-outs, and add dismissal/enforcement mechanics to help close quickly.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you for the draft. We made a light clean-up pass to tighten the mechanics and add standard carve-outs so the agreement is workable on execution. Please confirm the settlement amount and payment timing, and we can turn a final draft quickly.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims, disputes, and potential disputes between them arising out of or relating to the matters at issue, without any admission of liability.
edits.name: Recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Within ten (10) business days after execution of this Agreement, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the Settlement Amount by wire transfer or other mutually agreed immediately available funds. The parties will complete any reasonably necessary payment instructions promptly after execution.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full, Plaintiff, on behalf of itself and its agents, attorneys, successors, and assigns, irrevocably releases and forever discharges Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, insurers, agents, and representatives from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, damages, costs, and expenses of every kind, known or unknown, asserted or unasserted, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue through the Effective Date.
edits.name: Release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential, except that disclosure is permitted to the parties’ attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, insurers, and immediate family members as reasonably necessary, or as required by law, subpoena, court order, or to enforce this Agreement; provided that any compelled disclosure shall be limited to the minimum necessary and the disclosing party shall give prompt notice if legally permitted.
edits.name: Confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability or wrongdoing by Defendant, and it shall not be used or construed as such in any proceeding, except to enforce this Agreement. The parties shall execute any additional paperwork reasonably necessary to dismiss the action with prejudice after payment is made.
edits.name: No Admission / Dismissal
